# `core/compression/index.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/compression/index.js`

Compression Module - Unified Compression System Provides compression for all engine data types: - Particles: 390x compression (VLInt + Delta + Quantization + PCA/DCT) - Meshes: 70-90% reduction (Quantization + Octahedral normals + VLInt indices) - Voxels: 80-95% reduction (RLE + Octree + Palette) - Animations: 60-80% reduction (Quaternion + DCT + Keyframe reduction) All compression techniques are lossless or near-lossless with configurable quality.
